command: pnpm exec vitest run --config work/performance-vitest.config.ts --reporter verbose
functional_sanity: Each case produced at least one debt-minimum event per synthetic debt.
Pending obligation count matched the synthetic debt count.

interpretation: Measurements are local selector/plan timings only. The estimateRisk field is the existing estimate function output, not a newly defined acceptance threshold.
